current_coloc_gwas.evidence: Corgi+ was trained for RNA-to-epigenomic imputation, not on MASLD GWAS or COLOC outcomes. The family paper's GTEx eQTL demo concerns Regular Corgi, so Corgi+ has no released signed-variant scoring path.

gse244832.evidence: GSE244832 predates the checkpoint and exact ENCODE/FANTOM donor aliases for the 102-sample imputation subset are not checkpoint-bound. Its same-sample-different-aliquot RNA/ATAC relationship also does not satisfy a same-cell or same-nucleus local-RNA pairing claim.

gse281160.evidence: GSE281160 became public after the byte-identical February weight. Perturb-seq was not used in Corgi-family training and Corgi+ has no perturbation objective.

gse281364.evidence: GSE281364 became public after the byte-identical February weight and is absent from the declared Corgi-family corpus. It is not a topology-valid Corgi+ training source.

gse289173.evidence: Corgi+ training targets contain no MASLD labels, donor eQTLs or interaction-eQTL effects. Exact upstream sample aliases remain incomplete, so label exposure is provisionally excluded with medium confidence. The sealed source does not currently expose the full stranded local-RNA plus baseline input bundle required by the released design.

gse296875.evidence: GSE296875 is not one of the two named healthy 10x multiome sources and is absent from the declared 102-sample imputation subset. Its same-nucleus RNA/ATAC can support development only if alignment-derived stranded local RNA is available; a UMI gene-count matrix is insufficient.

resource_atlas_current.evidence: No Atlas MASLD labels or frozen programs were Corgi+ targets. Atlas UMI pseudobulk can supply global trans-regulator context, but it does not supply the local stranded total-RNA coverage required by final Corgi+ unless aligned reads are available and processed.

interpretation: Corgi+ has the strongest conceptual fit to RNA-conditioned accessibility but the released object is not currently executable or input-complete for project data. Contamination is not the main blocker: checkpoint mode, loader, mean baseline, local RNA coverage and exact transforms are unresolved.

missingness_rules.gene_counts: Do not reinterpret gene-level UMI counts as 64-bp stranded total-RNA coverage.
missingness_rules.local_rna: Use observed only when alignment-derived coverage is available; otherwise use derivable_not_processed, structurally_missing or unavailable_permission as appropriate.
missingness_rules.mean_baseline: Compute inside each training fold and mask unavailable assay-context combinations. Never compute from held donors or the sealed source.
missingness_rules.pairing: GSE296875 is same-nucleus RNA-ATAC. GSE244832 is same-sample-different-aliquot and supports donor-compatible comparison only.

rules.checkpoint_chronology: Use the February 2026 object date because the June paper archive repeats identical size and MD5.
rules.genome_overlap: The upstream imputation model used all 14395 Corgi windows. Local project adaptation must cross donors with held chromosome/LD blocks and a 524288-bp boundary buffer.
rules.sealed_rule: Do not synthesize, tune or recalibrate a Corgi+ input path after GSE289173 labels or QTL outcomes are opened.
rules.target_mask: RNA supplied as input cannot be scored as an independently predicted output. Restrict the primary track to ATAC/accessibility and other non-input epigenomic channels.

upstream_corpus.source_scope: subset of Corgi contexts with total RNA, DNase and at least one histone assay
